title: Skyblock gets a complete island economy
summary: A dedicated island bank, merchant, usable warehouse, social islands and deeper progression make every resource useful on Java, Bedrock and mobile.
body:
- Skyblock now uses a dedicated shared island bank instead of the global minigame wallet. Every credit, purchase, fee and upgrade is recorded in an auditable Skyblock ledger.
- A merchant on every island provides guaranteed buy and sell prices for common resources, with safe daily limits so a new island can progress without depending on another game or an empty player market.
- Warehouse resources can be withdrawn safely into the Minecraft inventory. Deposits and withdrawals use recoverable transfers so reconnects and full inventories cannot duplicate or lose a stack.
- Market prices, quantities, unit prices, totals, fees and proceeds are presented consistently. Java, Bedrock and mobile share the same 5% fee and 48-hour listing policy.
- Co-op owners can transfer ownership; members can leave; invitations can be declined or revoked; role changes are audited. Owners and managers alone may spend the shared bank.
- Islands stay private by default but can be published for read-only visits. Players can browse profiles, warp, return home and leave one unique like without being able to alter another island.
- Collections, bounded skill perks, worker upgrades, quests and deterministic daily or weekly objectives provide clearer long-term goals and rewards.
- The Cookie Build app separates the global Kit Shop, the Skyblock Merchant and the player-to-player Market. It supports worker upgrades, objectives and granular opt-in sale, full-worker and ready-objective notifications with quiet hours.
- Economy and retention health are visible through aggregate dashboards covering money creation and destruction, merchant volume, market liquidity, storage invariants, sessions and D1/D7/D30 return rates.

Java: play.cookie-build.com
Bedrock: play.cookie-build.com, port 19132
